name: Latex
notes: Latex refers to "a suspension of tiny polymer particles that are held in any liquid medium". The most famous source of latex is rubber tree. It is used to make rubber, but it itself is not rubber. Latex rubber (natural rubber) is used in mattresses for sleeper-cabs (of Class 8 combination trucks).
